name: Shooter
description: Twin-stick and first-person shooting: target acquisition, trigger discipline, ammo pressure, and cover. The pack's spine is the fire pipeline — combat.weapon_loadout turns intent into combat.fireRequested, combat.ammo_economy counts the bullet, combat.projectile_system flies it, combat.damage_resolver settles the hit — with combat.cover_system, combat.aim_assist, and presentation.hit_feedback shaping positioning, accessibility, and feel around that spine.
loop: acquire target → fire/manage ammo → take cover/reposition → clear

signatureCompound.name: Twin-Stick Firefight
signatureCompound.description: One arena, one armed player, waves of pathing enemies: the trigger pipeline (loadout → ammo → projectile → damage) runs under sustained pressure while cover and hit feedback keep the exchange readable. If this loop feels fair and legible, the pack works.
